sample_status: All 2021-2026 observations have been opened; every historical comparison is exploratory, not a new final test.
common_interval: 2024-01 through the A2 December 2025 signal exit
earlier_interval: 2021-2023 previously reused validation; descriptive execution robustness only, not an untouched holdout
additional_interval: B0 and B2 through the August 2026 signal exit
E0: Unmodified V1.6 execution_v16.run_account; reconstruct and compare saved accounts without modifying them.
E1: Same scores, portfolio and costs; after turnover scaling project undersized partial sells to the nearest legal keep or full-exit target, then cancel lowest-priority rebalance orders if projected gross turnover exceeds the unchanged 80% budget. No daily risk trades.
E2: E1 plus pre-signal buy capacity gate, priority for overweight sells, and daily prior-close risk-only sell orders when an actual stock weight exceeds 5%, targeting 4.5% subject to lot, liquidity and price limits. Every non-target holding receives a daily full-exit retry until filled or selected again. No risk-only buys; daily risk and cleanup orders are outside the monthly rebalance budget.
lot_policy: Main board 100-share sell increments; STAR minimum 200 raw shares then 1-share increments; complete odd-lot exit permitted. Adjusted units use the provider factor as a proxy, not independently verified broker shares.
turnover_budget: 80% gross turnover applies after the initial account funding trade, consistent with V1.6; E2 risk-only sell orders are separate risk interventions.
cost_capacity_stress: Use V1.6 prespecified 15 bps slippage at CNY 1 million and base 5 bps slippage at CNY 10 million; E0 and E2 compared on identical B0 signals and periods.
horizon_diagnostic: All existing 28 frozen technical features, raw direction, fixed next-open to open 5/20/60 trading-day labels; report monthly Rank IC and five-bin returns separately for 2017-2020, 2021-2023, and already-opened 2024-2026. No horizon is selected on the opened period.
pairwise_diagnostic: One same-date pairwise logistic model on eight frozen features, deterministic 150 stock pairs per mature month, prior 60 mature months, and a Ridge ranking control. Compare Rank IC only; no portfolio promotion on opened data.
risk_diagnostic: One fixed 252-day rolling covariance comparison: sample, diagonal and Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage; evaluate subsequent 20-day realized variance calibration for deterministic equal-weight stock baskets, with no return optimization.
decision: Never promote a candidate using opened-history E0/E1/E2 return; compare execution feasibility, account identity and concentration first. No iteration of the frozen rules based on resulting return.
